clips.title: The story
paras: At the Sepulcher, Apothecary Renferrel brews Quinn's Potion to help an injured scout recover. Quinn Yorick needs it after a disastrous patrol in Silverpine Forest.

Apothecary Renferrel brews a remedy for Deathstalker Quinn Yorick. Word reached the Royal Apothecary Society at the Sepulcher after Quinn was badly hurt and left unable to move near the Ivar Patch. Renferrel made the draught to help him recover. Though minor field casualties rarely draw Renferrel from his darker research for Lady Sylvanas, he supplied the remedy so the scout could regain enough strength to travel.
